note: Deviates from per-week Fama-MacBeth: week FE is undefined within a single week's cross-section, and per-week stock FE (50 dummies for ~50 obs) leaves no residual d.o.f. Estimated instead as a pooled two-way (stock+week) FE panel regression with SEs clustered by week (also addresses calendar-clustering).
